notes.title: BoomBox Full Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39301658/942dfd0f3f8f72a5b5fa65a73a00d80ac7b2a12a.gif[/img]
BoomBox Full Release is officially out on Steam! Thank you so much for your patience and support. We wouldn't have been able to do this without you all💗
Thank you and please, enjoy the game 🎮

*Enjoy our fantastic community on [url=https://discord.gg/r45JNqm6Nn]Discord[/url]

[b]Patch Notes (Game) [/b]
[list]
[*] Multiplayer added, players can play with up to 4 people on any official map
[*] Leaderboard frames added, players can show a frame around their name in the leaderboards
[*] New achievement system and unlockable/customizations for drumsticks, Pupa, and leaderboard frames
[*] 7 new official maps + Remapped older ost maps
[*] Gameplay optimization for smoother note and obstacle movement
[*] Resetting to default settings now only resets the settings visible on the page
[*] Confirmation message for resetting settings to default during gameplay and in lobby
[*] Controller rotation settings changed from increments of 5 to increments of 2
[*] Patch notes screen added
[*] Gameplay and song-selection tutorial added
[*] Input sampling duration for aim score has been reduced by half
[*] Drum room layout updates
[*] Pupa AI updates
[*] Default settings updated for Index/Oculus/Vive controllers
[*] Minor graphical fixes for many environments
[*] Discord button added to redirect to our discord
[*] Note pulsing effect has been re-implemented (can be toggled on/off in the settings)
[*] TV preview has been made slightly more readable
[*] Minor UI visual updates
[*] Removed Boombox logo from spectator camera
[*] Transition texture update, is more HD
[/list]

[b]Patch Notes (Editor)[/b]
[list]
[*] New Panel system added. General controls are now placed in the upper part of the screen
[*] Most used controls (mirror, copy, paste, delete, undo, zoom, bookmarks) are now placed in a panel at the right of the screen.
[*] Left panel showing top-down view of the notes timeline added.
[*] All main panels can be shown and hidden.
[*] Mirror selected notes horizontally and vertically
[*] Rotate selected notes clockwise and counterclockwise
[*] Swap left-right selected drummables (no effect on walls)
[*] Undo fully implemented
[*] Left and right hand drummable colors can be changed
[*] Song, metronome and note volumes can be set independently
[*] Sounds for metronome and note are independent
[*] Options for pasting only drummables of walls from selection
[*] Options for inverse mouse camera rotation (horizontal and vertical)
[*] Ability to set preview start time from top panel ( will be shown as a big blue arrow)
[*] Bookmarks are now shown in the 3D view as well as in the timeline at the bottom of the screen.
[*] Clicking a bookmark either from the timeline or in the 3D view will move the playline there
[*] Changing / adding / deleting BPM will adjust bookmark positions
[*] Achievements added (hint: farts :D )
[*] New shortcuts added. Shortcuts are shown in the panel (top of the screen)
[*] More visible outline for note selection
[*] Non square images can be used as .bom file cover images
[*] Song name and current time shown at the bottom left
[*] Toasts (messages) showing when a map has been successfully saved / uploaded to the server
[/list]

notes.title: BoomBox 2.0.0. OFFICIAL RELEASE
notes.content:
BoomBox 2.0.0, Jun 11 2021, 8:00 pm. OFFICIAL RELEASE

We are thrilled and happy to announce the official release of Boombox.

We want to thank you all for your support. We couldn't be here without all your help :D

BoomBox V 2.0.0

[list]
[*] Multiplayer added, players can play with up to 4 people on any official map
[*] Leaderboard frames added, players can show a frame around their name in the leaderboards
[*] New achievement system and unlockable/customizations for drumsticks, Pupa, and leaderboard frames
[*] 7 new official maps + Remapped older ost maps
[*] Gameplay optimization for smoother note and obstacle movement
[*] Resetting to default settings now only resets the settings visible on the page
[*] Confirmation message for resetting settings to default during gameplay and in lobby
[*] Controller rotation settings changed from increments of 5 to increments of 2
[*] Patch notes screen added
[*] Gameplay and song-selection tutorial added
[*] Drum room layout updates
[*] Pupa AI updates
[*] Default settings updated for Index/Oculus/Vive controllers
[*] Minor graphical fixes for many environments
[*] Discord button added to redirect to our discord
[*] Note pulsing effect has been re-implemented (can be toggled on/off in the settings)
[*] TV preview has been made slightly more readable
[*] Minor UI visual updates
[*] Removed Boombox logo from spectator camera
[*] Transition texture update, is more HD
[/list]

notes.title: Boombox Early Access 1.9.2
notes.content:
[h1]Patch notes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Server authentication updates, scores should submit to the server with no issue
[*]Notes/gameplay elements are snapped to player z position
[*]Hitboxes are rotated to match notes
[*]'Input' hitboxes added to prevent double tapping issue on high bpm songs with jacks, but still allow for vibros
[*]Size of top/bottom outer hitboxes have been adjusted to be more consistent with each other
[*]Slow scroll speed hitboxes have been adjusted
[*]Frame sampling: use +- 55ms instead of 8 90hz frames to sample input
[*]Aim: position is interpolated for more accurate aim hit results
[*]Direction: target direction is more accurate, used to be ether up/down, horizontal, or 45deg
[*]Direction scoring: more lenient, allow hits up to ~75deg perpendicular to drum face for full scoring
[*]Timing is made a bit more strict, added slight tolerance so 100% score is more achievable
[/list]

[b]Link to "How Boombox Scoring Works" document[/b]

[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vQt0hfBciekdaa9zJyBf1g_5onldYmdGXXIFWi3-Kncrdo--WdIAb-V7wFtX90iFG7HiYWakwl_fWa-/pub]How Boombox Scoring Works[/url]

[h1]Important[/h1]

[b]Scores submitted on the server will be recomputed after this patch. Please note that the gameplay has been changed and that previous scores will be using the old hitboxes/frame samples. 

Generally it should be easier to beat previous scores, but vibro styled maps will be more difficult to beat[/b]

notes.title: Boombox Early Access 1.6.3
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes v1.6.3[/b]
[list]
[*] New lobby UI. Includes a new environment selection panel, and some prettier settings menus.
[*] The lobby has gotten a makeover.
[*] Song Speed gameplay modifiers are now available. (Changing speed will disable online score submission)
[*] The currently selected environment can now be locked to prevent changing to a map's recommended environment when switching songs.
[*] Online leaderboard now always displays your score along with surrounding scores without needing to be in the top 10.
[*] New skyboxes on some environments. (Simple Crystal, Simple Rocks, Simple Snow, Sandy Night, Dragon, Alien Planet)
[*] The middle[*] three drum placements on the top row raised slightly to prevent vision blocking.
[*] Default drum height lowered by about 15cm to make the game feel more comfortable when playing at your real height settings.
[*] Timing window for perfectly timed hits has been changed to be more accurate. Previously the timing window favoured late hits.
[*] Obstacles are now slightly easier to dodge. Previously they could hit the player just before touching them.
[*] Twitch chat's default position in the lobby changed to not cover the new UI.
[*] Performance optimizations on all environments.
[*] Performance optimizations during gameplay related to Unity's garbage collector.
[*] Performance optimizations on the Twitch emote rain.
[*] Fix for hit detection on the most insanely dense note placements. (ultra[*] vibros)
[*] More fixes for index controller haptics under certain conditions.
[*] Updated Discord Rich Presence to include time remaining in the song during gameplay.
[*] To all the doubters, the puzzle[*] cube in the lobby was actually solvable, and to prove that, it has been solved.
[/list]

[b]Boombox Editor (v 0.1.3)[/b]
[list]
[*] Our entire library of 250 songs for community mapping can now be previewed and downloaded straight through the editor.
[*] Pressing F1 toggles both a human body reference and floor height reference.
[*] Loading messages have been added.
[*] Note positions adjusted to match gameplay.
[*] Audio volume has been normalized to -10 db.
[/list]

notes.title: Boombox Beta 1.2.4 (Hotfix)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39301658/38cfd9baff3c41c319c292d0ff1f13c31366c49a.png[/img][list]
[*] Hit SFX now sync more accurately on time to the hits
[*] One new simple environment added
[*] Forest environment optimized
[*] Spectator UI and results UI difficulty display is updated appropriately
[*] Live leaderboards bug fixed (now should toggle on when enabled)
[*] Hot-start issue fixed when pausing and resuming before the first note starts
[*] Fixed bgm/sfx volume on start
[*] Pupa lighting issue fixed
[*] Audio pooling bug fixed
[*] Network logging bug fixed
[/list]

[b]New Features :[/b]

[list]
[*] LIV implemented
[*] Settings for hold-to-pause and pause key bindings implemented
[*] Controller adjustment settings (x,y,z offsets, rotation) implemented
[*] Latency settings implemented for audio, visual, and positional
[*] 3 'simpler' environments added, one polished
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes / Quality updates :[/b]

[list]
[*] Leaderboard bugs fixed. Top scores now load, and lag issues addressed.
[*] Scoring system updates, 'combo attack' now caps at 50x combo, 1.2x points
[*] Accuracy system updated. now the % of score/max score instead of 'hit average'
[*] Hit SFX now sync more accurately on time to the hits
[*] Grading system updated. SS = 98%+, S+ = 95%+, S=90%, A=85%+, B=80%, C=70%+
[*] Map difficulty names changed (insane->expert, expert->master)
[*] Hot-start issue fixed when pausing and resuming before the first note starts
[*] Leaderboards added on maps that were missed (empire of steel, pointers, etc)
[*] Fixed bgm/sfx volume on start
[*] Pupa lighting issue fixed
[*] Audio pooling bug fixed
[*] Network logging bug fixed
[/list]

[b]Notes :[/b]
[list]
[*] Online scores will be re-calculated so that they'll be retained for the VALV Olympics, but please keep in mind that an update to the core gameplay will result in a score wipe in the future
[*] Local scores (replays) are locally stored and will be re-calculated locally. There will be a discrepancy with the online scores until the time being.
[/list]

Please join our amazing Community on [url=https://discord.gg/3SFpNJKb9u]Discord[/url] to stay up to date, share custom maps, and much more!
The Cybespline Team
